OER 9 Terminal Headlamp Switch 1968-1985 DeVille Eldorado Fleetwood Calais

Reproduction 9-terminal headlamp switch for a wide variety of 1968-1992 Cadillac models and 1994-1996 Buick Commercial Chassis models. This switch mounts on the dash and controls the flow of electrical current to the headlamp system. Each switch comes without the knob or shaft, sold separately. Replaces GM part numbers 1995171, 1995181, 1995196, 1995197, 1995211, 1995225.

Buick Applications:

1994-96 Commercial Chassis

Cadillac Applications:

1968-76 Calais

1968-93 DeVille

1968-85 Eldorado

1968-92 Fleetwood
